methodology: Official venue and operator pages were checked through web search/open; structured business lookups were used for location and closure cross-checks. Research does not certify live availability or a physical inspection. Descriptions are original paraphrases, not venue marketing copy.

michelin_summary.title: Michelin status in Antalya
michelin_summary.text: The published 2026 MICHELIN Guide Türkiye restaurant selection covers Istanbul, İzmir, Muğla and Cappadocia, not Antalya province. No Michelin star, Bib Gourmand, Green Star or Selected restaurant label has therefore been assigned to these Antalya profiles. Nationwide expansion has been announced; recheck the next published selection before making later-edition claims.
michelin_summary.next_edition_note: Reporting states the 2027 national selection will be announced on 3 December 2026; it was not yet published on the research date.

restaurants.title: 7 Mehmet
restaurants.excerpt: An Antalya institution pairing regional Turkish recipes with seasonal Mediterranean cooking.
restaurants.description: 7 Mehmet traces its history to 1937. Its Antalya restaurant is in Atatürk Kültür Parkı in Meltem, rather than inside Kaleiçi. The kitchen describes a seasonal approach rooted in local producers and traditional Turkish dishes interpreted with modern Mediterranean techniques.

sections.heading: Food and setting
sections.body: This is a useful choice for a meal focused on Antalya’s culinary identity. The official site separates its Antalya and Istanbul restaurants, so check the branch when making plans. Its other guide awards should not be confused with a Michelin distinction.

sections.body: The official resort page lists handicap limits of 28 for men and 36 for women. Confirm current visitor access, green fees, any resort-package inclusion, lessons and seasonal maintenance before booking.
